programme.desc: Nurse Kristen Gilbert is convicted of three counts of first-degree murder after several of her patients die from inexplicable heart attacks.

programme.desc: Police make an arrest in the contract killing of a California businessman and realize it's just the beginning of the story.

programme.title: Obsession: Dark Desires
programme.desc: When Olympic gold medalist Sheila Taormina agrees to coach an athlete, she doesn't realize he harbors dark fantasies that will turn her life into a living nightmare.

programme.title: Murder Comes to Town
programme.desc: The townspeople of Glendive, Mont., are paralyzed with fear after Susan Casey vanishes, and the investigation leaves everyone wondering if one of Casey's former flames is harboring a sinister secret, or if someone else is stalking their town.

programme.title: Most Shocking
programme.desc: A catfight tears up the dance floor in a Florida nightclub; a raging racer gets into a rival's face feet-first; soccer hooligans clash in a pregame rumble.

programme.desc: A lead-footed drug addict leads police on a chase; a routine traffic stop takes a harrowing turn when a woman jumps off a bridge, taking an officer with her; a drug runner gets nabbed with cocaine.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms crack federal cases involving drugs, arson and weapons.

programme.title: The New Detectives
